research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: YourChoice Therapeutics is researching contraceptive compounds and dosing to reduce likelihood of conception, produce reversible infertility in males, and selectively lower sperm count, as described in work on contraceptive compounds and dosing for the same. They also develop niclosamide formulations and methods of use as contraceptive, focusing on unisex, hormone free, on demand options. Together these efforts target male fertility modulation and non hormonal unisex contraception.
